name: Hide Without Show
hint: The finder detects an actor that is hidden and later receives visible changes without a reachable show block. Movement and appearance changes can then occur while the actor remains invisible, making the program appear not to react.
instruction: Show the actor before visual changes that should be seen, or remove those changes when remaining hidden is intentional.

when green flag clicked
